meta.title: DSH Connect DuMate (Baidu DuMate)
meta.description:
Connects the Baidu DuMate account already signed in on this machine to DeepSeek Harness: its models show up directly in the model picker, and chat goes through DuMate's own cloud model gateway by default, so the desktop app does not need to be running. Credit balance, packages and expiry, 7-day spend and the daily check-in state are read-only, shown in a composer capsule and under Settings → DuMate.

Prerequisite: install the DuMate desktop app (https://www.dumate.cn/download) and sign in once. This plugin does not register accounts, does not sign in for you and does not accept a manually pasted token — it uses the login state already on this machine, so every user runs on their own account.

Data boundary: the encrypted cookies and the decryption key are used in memory on this machine only; plaintext cookies are never written to disk or printed. Requests go only to Baidu's own hosts — no third party, no telemetry. The single write operation is claiming the daily check-in, which is off by default and only happens when you press the button or explicitly enable it. Full details in docs/PRIVACY.md inside the package.

No inflation: the personal-edition catalog publishes no per-model credit multiplier, so none is shown. Model ids are DuMate SKU labels, not vendor model names (measured: glm-5 is served by DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash); the plugin only records the real backend after the upstream reports it in a response header, and never names a model on the upstream's behalf.
